How To Buy Saitama

 

01

Go to dex.saita.pro or access it through the SaitaPro app by tapping on ‘Swap’.

02

Click on Connect and select MetaMask or Wallet connect depending on the wallet you use. On browsers we recommend using the MetaMask Google Chrome plugin.

03

Make sure you hold a small amount of Ethereum (ETH) in your wallet to pay for the gas fees.

04

Select ETH on the top menu and SAITAMA at the bottom. Enter the amount you want to swap to get the amount received

05

Click on the cogwheel menu and set ‘slippage’ to 9% to make sure the transaction goes through.

06

Click on ‘Swap’ and approve the transaction in your wallet app or plugin.
